# GEO的基本定义

分类：观点讨论

## 中文全文

生成式引擎优化，是对网站和内容进行结构化组织，让大语言模型和 AI 搜索引擎能够准确理解、引用并推荐你的企业。

## 外文原文

Generative Engine Optimization is the practice of structuring your website and content so large language models and AI search engines can accurately understand, cite, and recommend your business.
